boxes.meaning: set out, leave on a journey

english.meaning: set out, leave on a journey
english.note: Use this when someone sets out on a journey, especially when stating the departure time or destination.

examples.english: We depart for Taipei at eight tomorrow morning.
examples.traditional: 我哋聽朝八點出發去台北。
